gen-gf-unkempt-fs-ranade: Expressive from the first word, Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight. Ranade follows in sans-serif form, with a faint rubber-cord swell in the stroke and widely spaced letters that give the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-supreme: Unkempt's t has a crossbar and stem cut to matching weight, and its c never closes into an o. Supreme sets a dense, heavy-looking sans strip beneath it, crisp and held open.
gen-gf-unkempt-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and clean, its tall x-height filling the line. Unkempt takes the heading with its looser, commanding display shapes, and the shorter lowercase there lets the body's size stand out underneath.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-orbit: Commanding at the top, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched in weight. Orbit then runs below in sans-serif, each character floating apart, its curves stopping short and its strokes rope-like throughout.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic is a friendly plain sans whose stroke ends sit far apart and whose letters have no thick and thin parts. Unkempt sits above it with an expressive display voice, its c kept clearly distinct from an o.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-syncopate: That crossbar on the t matches its stem in weight, giving Unkempt a blunt, expressive stamp as the heading. Syncopate settles beneath it as plain sans, technical-pen steady, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder.
gen-gf-unkempt-manrope: Unkempt leads with an expressive, commanding display hand, its t built from a matching crossbar and stem. Manrope, a sans-serif with bright open curves and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, gives the pair its strongest quality: a clear shift in character.
gen-gf-unkempt-montserrat: Unkempt brings its expressive display shapes up top, with the c kept well apart from the o. Montserrat follows in sans, geometric and approachable, its oversized e and a counters gliding like wire under the eye.
gen-gf-unkempt-satoshi: Satoshi reads approachable, with a soaring x-height and a wide e that never squeezes shut. Satoshi handles the quiet, steady text work, while Unkempt is best at the commanding display moments, its t built from a matching crossbar and stem.
gen-gf-unkempt-switzer: A matching crossbar and stem make Unkempt's t instantly recognizable. Switzer, a sans with tubular, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line, is better at quiet reading, while Unkempt is better at commanding attention.
